steps.message: Write a one-sentence natural-language spec for an AXI4-Stream skid buffer (2-deep). Spec only, no code.

An AXI4-Stream skid buffer is a two-register pipeline stage that decouples a producer from a consumer by allowing the producer to assert one additional beat of data after the consumer deasserts `tready`, thereby absorbing a single cycle of back-pressure latency while forwarding all AXI4-Stream signals (`tdata`, `tstrb`, `tkeep`, `tlast`, `tid`, `tdest`, `tuser`) with full throughput (one transfer per clock) and no combinational path between `tready` and `tvalid` in either direction.
